class MuscleImpedanceLayer:
    """Delayed native-muscle afferents; optional region-specific recruitment.

    Afferents reflect muscle/tendon path length, rate, and signed native
    force magnitude. The positive velocity sign is path *lengthening*.
    No external force estimate or knowledge of push timing is fed back.
    A brief recruitment leaky integrator decays naturally as tension
    disturbance disappears, allowing relaxation without hard switches.
    """
    def __init__(self,pb, gains=ImpedanceGains(), *,region='left_arm'):
        if region not in ('left_arm','right_arm','both_arms','lower_body'):
            raise ValueError('invalid anatomical recruitment region')
        self.gains=gains
        self.sense=AfferentSystem(pb,delay_s=gains.delay_s,filter_tau_s=.012)
        names=self.sense.names
        arm=lambda name: name.startswith(('m_left_','m_right_')) and any(
            s in name for s in ('biceps','brachialis','triceps','deltoid','pectoralis',
            'latissimus','forearm','brachioradialis','supraspinatus','infraspinatus',
            'subscapularis'))
        if region=='left_arm': self.mask=np.array([arm(n) and n.startswith('m_left_') for n in names])
        elif region=='right_arm': self.mask=np.array([arm(n) and n.startswith('m_right_') for n in names])

def update(self,pb,base):
        u=np.asarray(base,dtype=float)
        n=self.sense.n
        if u.shape!=(pb.model.nu,) or not np.isfinite(u).all() or ((u<0)|(u>1)).any():
            raise ValueError('invalid native excitation source')
        aff=self.sense.read(pb)
        force=np.asarray(aff['tensionProxyN'],float)
        if self.force_reference is None:self.force_reference=force.copy()
        # Slow running force reference: removes constant load without
        # labeling steady isometric tension as a disturbance.
        dt=float(pb.model.opt.timestep)
        self.force_reference+=np.clip(dt/.22,0,1)*(force-self.force_reference)
        dynamic_load=np.clip((force-self.force_reference)/
                             np.maximum(self.force_reference,12),0,1)
        stretch=np.asarray(aff['stretch'],float)
        demand=(self.gains.stretch*stretch+self.gains.load*dynamic_load)
        demand*=self.mask
        # Stable first-order release / recruitment. No positive effort
        # is demanded merely because a previous disturbance occurred.
        alpha=1-np.exp(-dt/self.gains.release_tau_s)
        self.held+=alpha*(demand-self.held)
        tonic=np.where(self.mask,self.gains.brace,0.)
        correction=np.clip(self.held+tonic,0,self.gains.max_delta)
        out=np.clip(u[:n]+correction,0,1)
        ctrl=u.copy();ctrl[:n]=out
        self.duration_s+=dt
        return ctrl,{
          'muscleDeltaMax':float(np.max(out-u[:n])),
          'muscleDeltaL1':float(np.sum(out-u[:n])),
          'stretchChannels':int(np.sum((stretch>.02)&self.mask)),
          'loadChannels':int(np.sum((dynamic_load>.02)&self.mask)),
          'regionalExcitation':float(np.mean(out[self.mask])),
          'regionalNativeTensionN':float(np.mean(force[self.mask])),

            want+=g.pressure_gain*pressure_err*self.calf

class JointIntentCoordinator:
    def __init__(self,pb, kp=12., kd=1.2, torque_cap=5., guard_weight=.38):
        self.pb=pb
        self.indices=np.array([pb.hinge_dadr[x] for x in TARGETS],int)
        self.guards=np.array([pb.hinge_dadr[x] for x in GUARDS],int)
        self.kp,self.kd,self.torque_cap,self.guard_weight=kp,kd,torque_cap,guard_weight
        self.last=None

    def compute(self,data,reference,baseline):
        model=self.pb.model
        baseline=np.asarray(baseline,float)
        assert baseline.shape==(model.nu,)
        # Read only current proprioception; no future trajectory knowledge.
        diff=np.zeros(model.nv)
        mj.mj_differentiatePos(model,diff,1.,data.qpos,reference)
        error=diff[self.indices]
        rates=data.qvel[self.indices]
        tau=np.clip(self.kp*error-self.kd*rates,-self.torque_cap,self.torque_cap)
        gain,passive=native_force_susceptibility(model,data)
        lever=muscle_moment_matrix(data,model.nu,model.nv)
        torque_per_unit=lever.T*gain[None,:]  # nv by nu
        target=torque_per_unit[self.indices,:]
        guard=torque_per_unit[self.guards,:]
        active=np.where(np.max(abs(target),axis=0)>0.03)[0]
        delta=np.zeros(model.nu)
        if active.size:
            # Normalized joint-torque objective, secondary whole-body leakage,
            # L2 effort cost to avoid unnecessary cocontraction.
            T=target[:,active]
            G=guard[:,active]
            reg=9.0
            A=np.concatenate((T, self.guard_weight*G,
                              np.sqrt(reg)*np.eye(len(active))),axis=0)
            b=np.concatenate((tau,np.zeros(len(self.guards)),np.zeros(len(active))))
            low=np.maximum(-DELTA_LIMIT,-baseline[active])
            high=np.minimum(DELTA_LIMIT,MAX_CONTROL-baseline[active])
            # Box constrained: negative releases antagonists; positive engages agonists.
            result=lsq_linear(A,b,bounds=(low,high),max_iter=60,lsmr_tol="auto")
            if not result.success:
                # Fail closed on poor solve (no experimental correction)
                pass
            else:delta[active]=result.x
        actual=target@delta
        self.last={"requestedIncrementNm":tau.tolist(),
                   "predictedIncrementNm":actual.tolist(),
                   "absoluteJointErrorsDeg":(abs(error)*180/np.pi).tolist(),
                   "peakDelta":float(max(abs(delta))),
                   "nActiveMuscles":int(np.sum(abs(delta)>1e-6)),
                   "residualNm":float(np.linalg.norm(actual-tau)),
                   "predictedGuardLeakNm":float(np.linalg.norm(guard@delta)),
                   "meanNativeTensionN":float(-np.mean(data.actuator_force)),
                   "meanNativeMuscleSpeedMps":float(np.mean(abs(data.actuator_velocity)))}
        return delta

      arrival=cfg.get('arrival_s',self.arrival_s)
      kp=cfg.get('kp',self.kp)
      kd=cfg.get('kd',self.kd)
      max_extra=cfg.get('max_extra',self.max_extra)
      z=float(np.clip(t/arrival,0,1))

      qadr,dof=self.refs[side]

      # return shoulder control to the inherited muscle controller rather
      # than forcing an indefinitely held extra activation.
      if t>=self.release_at:

        c=self.config

        if not (np.isfinite(x) and np.isfinite(v)):
            self.command[:]=0.;self.hipDose=0.;self.abortUpdates+=1
            return
        away_speed=max(0.,np.sign(x)*v)
        predicted_abs_x=abs(x)+c['lookaheadS']*away_speed
        urgency=smoothstep((predicted_abs_x-c['triggerPositionM']) /
                           (c['fullRecruitAtM']-c['triggerPositionM']))
        target_trunk=c['minimumTrunkFraction']+(1-c['minimumTrunkFraction'])*urgency
        self.trunkFraction=clamp(target_trunk,
                                self.trunkFraction-c['trunkSlewPer40ms'],
                                self.trunkFraction+c['trunkSlewPer40ms'])
        abort=bool(float(obs['armsSeatN'])>=c['armAbortN'] or

def allocate_shared_muscles(moment, tracking, posture, com, lateral, *,
                            priority=0.65, lateral_weight=0.15,
                            amplitude=0.24, tonic=0.025):
    """Return excitation and objective-conflict diagnostics.

    High priority is posture+COM. Lower-priority tracking and optional lateral
    assistance are attenuated ONLY when their projected muscle signs oppose
    the high-priority signal. Lateral synergy redundant with the safety demand
    is removed; novel lateral excitation is further budgeted.
    """
    m = np.asarray(moment, dtype=float)
    if m.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("moment must be [muscles, dofs]")
    nu,nv=m.shape
    vals=[np.asarray(x,dtype=float) for x in (tracking,posture,com,lateral)]
    if any(x.shape!=(nv,) for x in vals) or not np.isfinite(m).all() or any(not np.isfinite(x).all() for x in vals):
        raise ValueError("invalid or nonfinite muscle allocation inputs")
    if not all(np.isfinite(x) for x in (priority,lateral_weight,amplitude,tonic)):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite allocation gains")
    if not (0<=priority<=1 and 0<=lateral_weight<=1 and 0<=amplitude<=1 and 0<=tonic<=1):
        raise ValueError("allocation gains outside [0,1]")
    tracking,posture,com,lateral=vals
    # MuJoCo muscle transmission convention: positive contraction tension
    # creates generalized force opposite signed actuator_moment.
    s = -m@(posture+com)
    t = -m@tracking
    ell = -m@lateral
    overlap = float(np.dot(ell,s)/(np.dot(s,s)+1e-18))
    # A positive parallel component repeats an existing demand. A negative
    # component opposes safety and is never given extra priority.
    residual=ell-max(overlap,0.)*s
    against_task=(t*s<0)&(np.abs(s)>1e-12)
    against_lateral=(residual*s<0)&(np.abs(s)>1e-12)
    task=t.copy()
    task[against_task]*=1.-priority
    lat=residual.copy()
    lat[against_lateral]=0.
    raw=s+task+lateral_weight*lat
    peak=float(np.max(np.abs(raw))) if nu else 0.
    if peak <= 1e-12:
        ctrl=np.full(nu,tonic)
    else:
        ctrl=np.clip(tonic+amplitude*np.maximum(raw,0.)/peak,0.,1.)
    if not np.isfinite(ctrl).all():
        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite excitation")
    conflicts=(np.abs(s)*np.abs(t))
    diag={
        "opposingMuscleCount":int(np.count_nonzero(against_task)),
        "opposingMuscleFraction":float(np.mean(against_task)) if nu else 0.,
        "weightedConflictFraction":float(np.sum(conflicts[against_task])/(np.sum(conflicts)+1e-18)),
        "lateralAgainstSafetyCount":int(np.count_nonzero(against_lateral)),
        "lateralRedundancyProjection":overlap,
        "rawPeak":peak,
        "excitationMaximum":float(ctrl.max()) if nu else 0.,
        "excitationMean":float(ctrl.mean()) if nu else 0.,
        "musclesAboveHalfBudget":int(np.count_nonzero(ctrl>=tonic+amplitude*.5)),
        "priority":priority,
